decisions.reason: The modular navigation camera line has its own page, matches the firm's push toward flexible small-satellite sensors, and costs little to maintain, so the option stays open.
Space situational awareness demand is rising but still uncertain, and two years reveal too little to justify abandoning an extension built on core competencies at modest holding cost.
The newly launched radiation-hard camera line is close to the established offer and prominently presented, so its value is still unfolding and keeping it costs little.
The asteroid navigation camera is tied to long mission timelines and is only mentioned on the website, but one year is too early to judge, so the cheap option is kept while uncertainty resolves.
